constraints: UI observations and inputs used Zuse only.
Only public rendered DOM, CSS and screenshots were read.

confirmed.method: One initial trusted mole click; after activating the actual game tab through Zuse window.focus and window-scopedCTRL+2, the existing watch_until_click confirmed4 further trusted hits; five selected cells were observed, then Verify advanced.

observed_limits: background(true) emulates focus/activity but did not make an actually hidden browser tab's CSS animation advance in this scene.

The unchanged click watch succeeded after native tab activation; this is not evidence of a watch implementation defect.
The old fallback connection's last background cleanup receipt remains unread; current connection cleanup after successful batches is explicitly confirmed.
Screenshot file names do not establish a level transition; one file namedpure-l11.png was captured while still on Level10.
No all-level completion or quick-clear timing is claimed.
